subject: Extended evaluation credits for Private VPC — security clearance & evidence
messages:
From: Ellie Gomez <ellie.gomez@safeguardmed.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Nair <rajesh.nair@safeguardmed.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional eval credits for Private VPC POC (security gating)

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are ready to run the next security-focused phase of the Private VPC POC, but the security team needs a short extension and a small credit top-up so we can complete penetration testing and key rotation tests in an isolated environment.

Quick summary:
- What we need: 2 extra weeks of Private/VPC access + incremental credits to cover load during automated pen-testing (estimate: $6k–8k).
- Why: security artifacts and live tests (KMS rotation, encryption-at-rest verification, network isolation) must be validated before we expand to clinical workloads.
- What would unblock us: a SOC2 report excerpt or attestation, a short network isolation checklist, and confirmation of log retention (90 days).

Attached: rough POC SOW and a test plan. Can you advise what evidence you can provide and whether Redwood can temporarily extend credits while security signs off? If you prefer, Rajesh (cc) can join a short call to walk through the technical asks.

Thanks —
Ellie
Ellie Gomez
Technical Program Manager, Safeguard MedTech
ellie.gomez@safeguardmed.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Gomez <ellie.gomez@safeguardmed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional eval credits for Private VPC POC (security gating)

Ellie — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. We can support the extension in principle. To move quickly, please confirm the exact test window you need (start/end dates) and whether the work will require elevated support (agent/engineer on call).

For the security artifacts, please tell us if the following will be sufficient:
- SOC2 Type II excerpt highlighting controls relevant to inference/data handling (we can provide a redacted excerpt),
- Short network isolation checklist and temporary connectivity plan,
- KMS/HSM integration notes and a data retention policy (90 days is standard; we can confirm).

Ben — can you propose a provisional credit top-up and approval path? We should be able to provision a limited amount pending formal sign-off; prefer to make it conditional on a completed checklist and a signed SOW.

Ellie — copied Marissa (account lead) and Ben (sales ops) to coordinate next steps and paperwork. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ellie Gomez <ellie.gomez@safeguardmed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional eval credits for Private VPC POC (security gating)

Ellie/Vivek —

We can provision a provisional credit top-up to cover the two-week pen-test window. Proposed approval: $7,000 of trial credits applied to the Safeguard MedTech POC account, valid for the two-week window you confirm. Conditions:
- Credits are provisional and will be released when we receive the signed SOW (DocuSign) and the security checklist completed by your security team,
- If additional capacity is required beyond the window, we'll reassess.

I've attached a short approval stub (credits-approval-stub.pdf) that our finance team will use to track the allocation. Please confirm the exact start/end dates and send the procurement or PO contact so we can route the DocuSign for the SOW.

DocuSign link (for SOW): https://www.docusign.net/Member/StartInPersonSigning.aspx?doc=RW-2145-SOW

Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Gomez <ellie.gomez@safeguardmed.com>, Rajesh Nair <rajesh.nair@safeguardmed.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional eval credits for Private VPC POC (security gating)

Hi Ellie/Rajesh —

Attaching the SOC2 excerpt and a short network isolation checklist we use for Private VPC evals. Notes:
- SOC2 excerpt is redacted for customer-sensitive items but includes the control descriptions relevant to inference and data handling.
- Network checklist outlines required firewall rules, private subnet config, and temporary VPN access options.
- Log retention: Redwood retains API telemetry and audit logs for 90 days for POC accounts by default; we can extend to 180 days with an enterprise agreement.

Temporary access window we can provision once you confirm dates: proposed start 2027-03-22, end 2027-04-05. If you need a different window, say so and we'll adjust.

Attachments: SOC2-Excerpt-Redwood.pdf, POC-SOW-v0.3.docx

If procurement prefers the SOW signed first, we can route the DocuSign immediately; Ben has already provisionally okayed the credit allocation pending signature.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ellie Gomez <ellie.gomez@safeguardmed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional eval credits for Private VPC POC (security gating)

Marissa/Team —

Thanks — we received the SOC2 excerpt and checklist. Confirming the test window 2027-03-22 to 2027-04-05. Procurement will sign the SOW today and the PO contact is procure@safeguardmed.com.

We also confirm the pen-testing will require temporary elevated access (engineer on call) on the first two days; Rajesh will coordinate times. Please go ahead and provision the provisional $7,000 credit allocation and route the DocuSign to procure@safeguardmed.com.

Appreciate the fast turnaround —
Ellie
